description_zh: 查询多条网络优化配置
name: ListNetworkOptimizations

parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:

global: queries global configurations.
rule: queries rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, both global and rule configurations are returned
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置。

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You can use this parameter to query the rule that matches the specified name
parameters.help_zh: 规则名，可以查出规则名为所传字段的那条规则
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

Configs.description_en: The configurations returned in the response body

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:

global: global configuration.
rule: rule configuration
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置

Grpc.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable gRPC. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
Grpc.description_zh:
是否开启GRPC，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Http2Origin.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2 back-to-origin. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

on: enabled.
off: disabled
Http2Origin.description_zh:
是否开启HTTP2回源，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which uses conditional expressions to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0

SmartRouting.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the smart routing service. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
SmartRouting.description_zh:
是否开启智能路由服务，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

UploadMaxFilesize.description_en: The maximum upload file size, in MB. Valid values: 100 to 500
UploadMaxFilesize.description_zh: 最大上传文件大小，单位是MB，取值范围：100～500

Websocket.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable WebSocket. This feature is enabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
Websocket.description_zh:
是否开启Websocket，默认开启。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
